title: Machine Learning Engineer
text:
Machine Learning Engineer - Sample Vision Labs Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru
2 to 5 years

Responsibilities
- Train and evaluate models with PyTorch and scikit-learn
- Serve models behind APIs in Docker containers
- Track experiments and models with MLflow
- Build features from raw event data with pandas

Requirements
- Strong Python
- Machine learning fundamentals
- PyTorch
- scikit-learn
- Docker

Good to have
- Experience building LLM apps
- Kubernetes
- Weights & Biases

Hybrid, Koramangala.
